description_en: Queries the list of monitoring items supported by a Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例支持的监控项列表
name: DescribeMonitorItems

KVStoreMonitorItem.description_en:
The list of monitoring items.

The memoryUsage, GetQps, and PutQps monitoring metrics are supported only for instances that run version 4.0 or later. The GetQps and PutQps monitoring metrics require the instance to run the latest minor engine version. For information about how to upgrade, see [Upgrade the major engine version]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101764.html） and [Update the minor engine version]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56450.html）.
If the hit_rate monitoring metric is not displayed for an instance that is compatible with Redis 2.8, update the minor engine version. For more information, see [Update the minor engine version]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56450.html）
KVStoreMonitorItem.description_zh:
监控参数列表。

memoryUsage、GetQps和PutQps监控指标仅在4.0及以上版本的实例中支持。其中，GetQps和PutQps监控指标需要实例为最新的小版本。升级方法请参见[升级大版本]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101764.html）和[升级小版本]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56450.html）。
实例版本为兼容Redis 2.8版本时，如果没有展示hit_rate监控指标，您需要升级小版本，详情请参见[升级小版本]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/56450.html）
